# Lab 20.5: Billing Export to BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Export Cloud Billing data to BigQuery and build a cost report by service and by BigQuery SKU.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the destination dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab20_billing</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Turn on the export.** **Billing → Billing export → BigQuery export**:
   - **Standard usage cost** → project `bq-course-lab`, dataset `lab20_billing`
   - Optionally **Detailed usage cost** too

   Data starts arriving within a few hours and is updated several times a day.

3. **[SQL] Cost by service.** Replace the table name with the one created in your dataset.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT service.description AS service, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS cost
FROM lab20_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXXXX
WHERE invoice.month = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY service ORDER BY cost DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] BigQuery cost by SKU.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT sku.description AS sku, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS cost,
       ROUND(SUM(usage.amount_in_pricing_units), 2) AS usage, ANY_VALUE(usage.pricing_unit) AS unit
FROM lab20_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXXXX
WHERE service.description = 'BigQuery' AND invoice.month = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY sku ORDER BY cost DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You see separate SKUs for analysis (on-demand or slots), active storage, long-term storage and streaming.

5. **[SQL] Cost by label.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT l.value AS team, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS cost
FROM lab20_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXXXX, UNNEST(labels) AS l
WHERE l.key = 'team'
GROUP BY team;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Export | Billing rows land in BigQuery |
| By service | Where the money goes |
| By SKU | Compute vs storage vs streaming |
| By label | Team or project chargeback |
